description: Connects a subdomain to Halo Cloud identity via Cloudflare for SaaS. Creates a CNAME to Halo's SaaS target and a Cloudflare custom-hostname ownership TXT so TLS and routing can activate.
variableDescription: hostTarget is Halo's SaaS CNAME target (for example customers.halo.scala.gg). txtValue is the Cloudflare ownership verification token returned when the custom hostname is created.
